title: Asymptotic inference for skewed stable Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process
summary: We consider the parametric estimation of the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process driven by a non-Gaussian $α$-stable Lévy process with the stable index $α>1$ and possibly skewed jumps, based on a discrete-time sample over a fixed period.
